## Improved
- Play on: a redesigned sheet with a card for what plays (art, title, where it plays, the music player's controls and a thicker volume bar) and your devices right below it, without scrolling (#1412)
- Play on: the device you control is marked with a check, even while paused, and only the device you move playback to shows that it is moving (#1412)
- Play on: devices that are offline fold into one "Not available" row once there are two or more, and a new row opens Linked devices (#1412)
- Play on: the volume bar follows volume changes made on the device itself (#1412)
- Play on: the button uses a devices icon and matches the size of the other video player buttons (#1412)

## Fixed
- Linked devices: TVs and tablets show their own icon instead of a phone (#1412)
